en-US: Build 210: please test Office opening, editing and recovery; PDF/Office tabs inside the IDE; Git repository initialization; mind-map icon controls and free node movement; and Shell command/session recovery. Also test cross-task history lookup through to a final answer, long histories and resumed tasks, plus local-model tool calls and context compression. Linux, Python, Node and WASM now have separate package entries. An optional Linux environment can download the fixed image from its list; Shell, local Python and background services in that environment share its Python packages and files. Native execution remains the default. Matching Linux sources and notices are linked from the acknowledgements. This delivery uses focused code checks and the cloud App build; please perform device acceptance, including Linux performance and real SSH/SCP transfers. Office recovery copies are preserved, but an engine process failure may still require restarting the App.
zh-Hans: Build 210：请测试 Office 打开、编辑和恢复；IDE 内部的 PDF/Office 标签；Git 初始化仓库；思维导图的图标按钮与自由拖动；以及 Shell 命令和会话恢复。也请测试跨任务查询历史后能否完成最终答复，包含长历史与中断后继续，以及本地模型调用工具和上下文压缩。Linux、Python、Node、WASM 现有各自的包管理入口。可选的 Linux 环境支持从列表下载固定镜像，该环境的 Shell、local Python 和后台服务共用 Python 包与文件。原生执行保持默认，Linux 对应源码和版权材料可从许可声明查阅。本轮只做定向代码检查和云端 App 构建，真机验收交给你，包括 Linux 性能和真实 SSH/SCP 传输。Office 恢复副本会保留，但引擎进程真正失败后仍可能需要重启 App。
